FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Fire Support Importing
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Allows custom fire supports to be imported or exported, just like units and squads.

patchNoteLines.li: Allows custom fire supports to be imported or exported. Uses same design as unit and squad import/export

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Settlement Description Update
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Changes how settlement descriptions are created to let specific settlement types specify their own descriptions, e.g. orbital settlements having more space-themed descriptions.

patchNoteLines.li: Generate settlement descriptions based on optional new descriptionKey on WorldSettlementDef
Bugfix: when the player has the Militaristic policy and builds an Orbital settlement, a barracks building is added, even though barracks cannot be built on orbital settlements

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Orbital Settlement Fixes
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: A handful of fixes related to orbital settlements.

patchNoteLines.li: Bugfix: ReturnTicksToArrive() doesn't properly handle cross-layer pathfinding
Add canBeRaided and supportsManualBattle fields to WorldSettlementDef
Add virtual CanBeRaidedByFaction function to SettlementTypeExtension, allowing settlements to determine what kinds of factions can attack them. Defaults true
Use the new fields/functions to make Orbital Settlements raidable only by factions with Spacer tech or above. Orbital Settlements also do not support manual battles

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Russian Translation Update
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Minor update to the Russian translation.

patchNoteLines.li: Minor update to the Russian translation

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: TaxSpot bugfix
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Adds null guards to the tax payment codepath.

patchNoteLines.li: Bugfix: unexpected null def causes errors on paying taxes

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Backend Fixes
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Adds a number of null checks and guards, with the aim of hardening Empire against errors when being added to an ongoing save.

patchNoteLines.li: Add numerous null checks and guards

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Fixes & Updates
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: A couple of fixes and a small update.

patchNoteLines.li: Update orbital settlement descriptions for the settlement type picker
Bugfix: clicking the 'Resolve Bill' button may not make the bill disappear when it should
Adds Synthread and Hyperweave to the Apparel resource, gated behind the Ultra tech level

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Craft & Building Fixes
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Fixes a couple of bugs with item pricing and build times.

patchNoteLines.li: Bugfix: Non-stuffable Things would not have variable prices based on quality
Bugfix: the building build time multplier wouldn't apply when granted via building

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Orbital buildings fix
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Fixes an issue where several orbital buildings that are supposed to be locked to one type of orbital were actually buildable in any of them.

patchNoteLines.li: Orbital Trade Hub and Space Distillery only buildable on logistics orbital platforms
Orbital Shipyard and Orbital Surface Operations only buildable on advanced orbital platforms
Orbital Academy and Naval Academy only buildable on glitterworld orbital platforms
Update military tests to reflect the combat efficiency change from a little bit ago
Update settlement profit cache invalidation
